verses.1: And after Abimelech, he became the leader who would save Israel. His name was Pua, son of Dodoe. He was from the tribe of Issachar. He would reign in Shechem, on Mount Efrater.
verses.2: And he ruled over Israel for forty-three years. Then he died and was buried in Shemirah.
verses.3: And after him rose Yair the Giladite. He ruled over Israel for forty-two years.
verses.4: And he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And these thirty donkeys were used to carry things for them. They were called “Chawt Yair” until today, in the land of Gilad.
verses.5: And Yair died, and he was buried in his own home.
verses.6: And the children of Israel committed evil deeds in the eyes of Jehovah. They served their gods, the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon. They abandoned Jehovah and no longer served him.
verses.7: And Jehovah struck Israel, and they were sold into the hands of Philistines and into the hands of the sons of Ammon.
verses.8: And they attacked and killed the children of Israel during that year. It was twelve years in total. They killed all the children of Israel who were living across the Jordan River, in the land of the Amorites.
verses.9: And the sons of Ammon crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and Beth Efrayim. Many people from Israel were killed in those battles.
verses.10: And the children of Israel cried out to Jehovah, saying, “We have sinned against you. We have abandoned our gods and worshiped other gods instead.”
verses.11: And the LORD said to the children of Israel, “These are those who have come out of Egypt, from among the Amorites, from among the Canaanites, and from among the Philistines.”
verses.12: And Sidon, Ammon, and Moab will attack you. They will cry out to me for help, and I will save you from their hands.
verses.13: And you have abandoned me, and served other gods instead. Therefore, I will not continue to save you anymore.
verses.14: Go and cry out to the God whom you have chosen. He will save you in times of trouble.
verses.15: And the children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned. Do what you will for us, but please save us today.”
verses.16: And they removed the idols of those nations from among them, and they served Jehovah. Their hearts became humble through their labor in Israel.
verses.17: And the sons of Amun cried out, and they camped at Gilad. Then the sons of Israel also gathered together, and they camped at Mitspa.
verses.18: And the people of Gilad said to each other, “Who will be the man who will start fighting against the children of Canaan? He will become the leader of all the people of Gilad.”
